name: Stacked DR + R Pseudo-Outcome Ensemble
tagline: Cross-fits stacked outcome / propensity nuisances, then averages four CATE models trained on both DR and R-Learner pseudo-outcomes.
formula: $$\hat{\tau}(x) = \frac{1}{4}\sum_{j=1}^{4} g_j(x), \quad g_j \in \{\mathrm{GBR}, \mathrm{RF}\} \times \{\phi^{\mathrm{DR}}, \phi^{R}\}$$ where $$\phi^{\mathrm{DR}} = \hat\mu_1 - \hat\mu_0 + \frac{T(Y - \hat\mu_1)}{\hat e} - \frac{(1-T)(Y - \hat\mu_0)}{1-\hat e}, \quad \phi^{R} = \frac{Y - \hat m}{T - \hat e}, \quad w^R = (T - \hat e)^2.$$
init_recovers: DR-Learner if R-arm and RF heads disabled
diff_from_baseline: Versus DR-Learner / R-Learner, computes both pseudo-outcomes from a single stacked nuisance estimate (GBR+RF averaged), trains two CATE families per pseudo-outcome, and final-averages all four.

name: DR + Variance-Adaptive Trimming + Overlap Weights
tagline: DR-Learner with per-sample variance-aware trimming, overlap weighting, and a GBR+RF ensemble final stage.
formula: $$\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\phi_i) \propto \Big[\tfrac{T_i}{\hat e_i^2} + \tfrac{1-T_i}{(1-\hat e_i)^2}\Big]\sigma^2,\quad \tau_i = \sqrt{\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\phi_i)/\mathrm{med}(\widehat{\mathrm{Var}})}\in[0.5,2],$$ $$\tilde\phi_i = \mathrm{clip}(\phi^{\mathrm{DR}}_i,\, \pm q_{95}/\tau_i),\qquad w_i = \hat e_i (1 - \hat e_i),$$ $$\hat\tau(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}\big[\mathrm{GBR}_w(x) + \mathrm{RF}_w(x)\big].$$
init_recovers: DR-Learner when var_scale = 1 and overlap weight = constant
diff_from_baseline: Versus DR-Learner, replaces the constant percentile clip with a per-sample threshold scaled by sqrt(estimated DR variance), uses overlap weights e(1-e) at the second-stage regression, and averages a GBR + a deeper RF.

name: Overlap-Weighted Tri-Robust Ensemble (DR + R + X)
tagline: Ensembles variance-weighted DR, structural R-Learner, and a propensity-gated X-Learner; outcome models themselves are overlap-weighted.
formula: $$\hat\tau_{\mathrm{DR}} = \arg\min_g \sum_i \hat e_i(1-\hat e_i)\,\big(\phi^{\mathrm{DR}}_i - g(x_i)\big)^2,\qquad \hat\tau_R = \mathrm{GBR}\big(X,\, \tfrac{Y - \hat m}{T - \hat e};\, w=(T-\hat e)^2\big),$$ $$\hat m = \hat e\,\hat\mu_1 + (1-\hat e)\,\hat\mu_0,\qquad \hat\tau_X(x) = (1-\hat e(x))\,\hat\tau_1(x) + \hat e(x)\,\hat\tau_0(x),$$ $$\hat\tau(x) = \tfrac{1}{3}\big[\hat\tau_{\mathrm{DR}}(x) + \hat\tau_R(x) + \hat\tau_X(x)\big],\quad \hat\mu_1\,\text{trained with weight}\,1-\hat e,\ \hat\mu_0\,\text{with weight}\,\hat e.$$
init_recovers: Plain DR-Learner if R and X arms are dropped and overlap weights set to 1
diff_from_baseline: Versus single DR/R baselines, trains the outcome nuisances with overlap weights (1-e for treated, e for control), then averages three different meta-learners (DR weighted by e(1-e), R, X with propensity gate) all built from a shared cross-fit propensity score.

name: Balanced Orthogonal XDR + Plug-in Shrinkage
tagline: Mixes a propensity-gated X-Learner with a DR-Learner using a data-dependent gate, then adds a plug-in T-Learner shrinkage and a global bias correction.

key_hyperparams.name: alpha_low / alpha_high
key_hyperparams.role: X-Learner weight when better/worse than DR

diff_from_baseline: Versus DR-Learner, builds an X-Learner-style head (separate tau1, tau0 trained on imputed differences) and a T-Learner plug-in head, then convex-combines all three with weights chosen by comparing OOF MSEs against the DR pseudo-outcome, plus a centered global bias correction.

name: Y-Normalized DR Stack + Orthogonal Refinement
tagline: Standardizes X, normalizes Y, builds DR pseudo-outcomes, NNLS-stacks four CATE learners, then adds a residual refinement model with optimal blending lambda.
init_recovers: DR-Learner if stack_weights are one-hot on a single GBR and λ=0
diff_from_baseline: Versus DR-Learner, normalizes Y (so MAD-clipping is dataset-agnostic), stacks four diverse CATE learners with NNLS weights, then adds a second-stage residual refinement model whose blending weight λ is fit on OOF predictions. Predictions are denormalized by σ_Y.
